Name: Karl Serr
Description: Karl Serr's mutation activated in utero after his pregnant mother was caught in the same atomic blast that killed his father. Over the year's, Karl's mother came to believe that her husband had left her after Karl's birth, believing Karl to be a demon. Because she viewed her son as a demonic monster, "Aunt" Serr believed she was meant to take over the world and the only mate suitable for Karl was his own cousin, Lucile Serr.
